stage: Stage1-v6 focused glass recheck before body and component-interface freeze
scope: This clears the single Stage1-v5 glass blocker and accepts the preliminary body/material/interface basis for coordinator freeze. It does not approve final main asset, canonical component art, future cover/family publication, complete sprite consumer contexts or final 576 images/48 atlases.

resolvedV5Blocker.issue: Focal porthole previously read as a softly shaded, nearly uniform blue disc with weak glass depth/reflection.
resolvedV5Blocker.result: Resolved. The revised native material gives the lens a deeper blue surround, a lighter rounded interior reflection and a controlled curved highlight near the rim. It reads as stylized glass rather than a flat painted insert. These cues survive 320×384 logical and 160×192 half-logical display in N/E/S/W on light, gray and dark backgrounds, both without and with provisional equipment.

viewNotes.S: Curved pale-blue upper reflection and darker surrounding blue make the convex window and glass edge legible at its largest frontal presentation. The blue focal area remains dominant; there is no clipped white wash.
viewNotes.N: The smaller foreshortened oval still separates its blue depth from a restrained brighter reflection at the near edge, without a dark dead patch.
viewNotes.E/W: A broad blue-tinted oval reflection shifts coherently with the view while a deeper blue edge keeps the porthole distinct from its gold ring. The lighter region remains bounded and does not erase the blue glass.

resolvedV5Blocker.referenceInterpretation: A broader, simpler reflection than the target is accepted. Literal transparency, copied target glint direction/count, photoreal refraction or pixel identity were never required. No new decorative detail is demanded at this partial checkpoint.

Camera, renderer/frame/sampling/alpha settings, symmetric lights, world graph and color management.

independentNativeIdentity.normalization: The initial generic settings snapshot included Blender runtime session_uid and datablock users. Diagnostics show only those ephemeral fields differ outside the intended glass change. Valid v2 comparison excludes only these fields; the old blue material user count drops 2→1 because the independently checked glass material assignment moved. Raw diagnostics are retained in identity-metadata-diagnostics.json. No functional geometry/material/render difference was hidden.
independentNativeIdentity.shaderInspection: Actual new graph is static native nodes on the existing convex mesh: angle-dependent blue depth, reflected Incoming/Normal ray, world-Z elevation ramp, blue-tinted reflection and a polished Principled coat with restrained radiance. No horizontal X/Y azimuth branch, image texture, glint card, per-view material assignment, node animation, time/UV/position texture, Normal connection or Displacement connection was found. Alpha remains 1 and transmission 0. Stylized opaque glass is allowed.
independentNativeIdentity.shaderMotionImplication: Body/glass motion remains unchanged translation under each fixed orthographic facing. The static shader uses normal/view direction and reflection elevation rather than time or position, so it introduces no new geometry, opacity or shader-motion channel. Broad phase tests were not repeated once exact relevant identity was established.
